The pinned snapshot yields 6,898 unique cleaned held-out pairs: all 4,101 test observations are retained, while seven identical validation copies are suppressed by deterministic test > validation > train precedence. The default deterministic one-million-row train selection matches the current executable training ceiling without file-order bias; LEKH_NEURAL_AKSHARANTAR_TRAIN_ROW_CAP=full explicitly requests the complete train split on a measured high-memory host. It does not replace private human-reviewed Lekh gold.
